title: Separate a finite-alternative path obstruction from a stationary local score
statement: The adapted hidden linear reference reconstructs an error ODE from an augmented record, bounding port path KL by paid initial divergence plus a gain-squared time term. The separate local score at a=0 splits into a linear-shunt second-chaos likelihood score and an orthogonal fourth-chaos term. Its same-record local comparison does not establish a fixed-Delta g^4 path bound.

requires: Known one-defect M-matrix diffusion with all-coordinate independent mechanical bath excitation and only the specified observed port
Stated zero or stationary start and matching finite exposure/readout law; no actuated dynamics or altered bath
provides: A source-supported information comparison with the correct start and alternative
assumptions: The augmented cancellation is a law comparison, not access to hidden variables or an actuator
Finite noisy readouts are downstream processing, not free ideal measurements
costs: Actual observation duration, initialization, correlated read spacing, exposure integration, electronics and calibration
Exact coefficient/scalar compilation is not physical data; long exposure trades time and information under its declared noise law
contract.units: Native mechanical stiffness, temperature, variance and quartic coefficient units from the supplied Gibbs model; no automatic SI-time or device calibration conversion.
contract.obstruction: IID snapshots or local Fisher information cannot simply be substituted into a correlated transient experiment.

body: Local stationary and fixed-alternative/transient scopes do not transfer by analogy. The ordinary comparator is full temporal covariance likelihood, not only a variance statistic. K, bath, metric, temperature, one hidden quartic, readout and zero drive are supplied. Supporting scalar retention/variance packets do not complete the independent receiver, burn-in/calibration budget or a physical measurement. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Acquired completed whole scientific/code parent review at the explicitly separated mathematical/source-computation scopes. This does not accept another receiver stage or infer physical/novelty/advantage evidence.
